# MyOpen

> MyOpen Studio makes small, focused mobile apps. No accounts required.

## Taiwan Mahjong Now (台灣麻將 Now)

> 16-tile Taiwanese mahjong for iPhone. Play against the AI on your own,
> or open a table and play online with friends. Tai (台) scoring is
> calculated automatically.

Key facts:
- Ruleset: Taiwanese 16-tile mahjong — eight flower tiles, dealer streaks (連莊), tai scoring.
  It is not Riichi (Japanese) or Hong Kong mahjong.
- Platform: iPhone (App Store). iPad runs the iPhone version. No Android version yet.
- App languages: English and Traditional Chinese. Tile faces can be traditional
  Taiwanese artwork, Chinese characters, or English labels.
- Solo: play three AI opponents at your own pace, with no turn timer by default.
- Online: the host opens a table and shares a 6-character table code or QR code;
  empty seats are filled by the AI. No sign-up needed.
- Scores are counted in tai only. There is no in-game currency.
- Free to download, with ads (one full-screen ad per wind round, and a banner
  on the hand result screen).

- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6802663114)
- [Home (English)](https://www.myopen.app/mahjongnow/en/)
- [How to play](https://www.myopen.app/mahjongnow/en/how-to-play/): tiles, turns, chow / pung / kong, winning
- [Scoring (tai) table](https://www.myopen.app/mahjongnow/en/tai/): every scoring pattern with its tai value and an example hand
- [Why mahjong](https://www.myopen.app/mahjongnow/en/why-mahjong/)
- [繁體中文](https://www.myopen.app/mahjongnow/zh-hant/)
- [日本語（日本麻雀との違い・台数表）](https://www.myopen.app/mahjongnow/ja/)
- [Privacy policy](https://www.myopen.app/mahjongnow/privacy-policy)
- Support: support@myopen.app
